summary: Adversary verdict FAIL on plan 7f0276ef (docs/design/B12-outreach-plan.md, base 8354d7be): 2 BLOCKING, 13 MAJOR, 6 MINOR. Confirmed: both main defects (get-statement.ts:101 -> authorizer.ts:70 refuses a TERMINATED seller its statement; prospects_seller_read 0029:1351-1352 and prospect_suppressions_read 0029:1364-1365 use current_seller_id() of any state, contacts/source evidence self-read by recorded_by_user_id 0029:1341-1342 and 0029:1333-1334), KA095-097/KC028-033 unique (claimed only on refs/heads/b12/outreach across 386 refs and 123 worktrees; main KA max KA094, KC max KC027), migrations 0082/0083 free (main max 0070; worktrees claim 0071 x8, 0075, 0076) and provisional, provider-port and suppression-writer censuses (0 src hits), R2-067 deferral justified. Rejected: the per-sender new-recipient cap is serialized by a FOR SHARE lock (unenforceable, its RACE cell unreachable); SEND_UNCERTAIN reconciliation lets a repeat follow a human observation that the message WAS sent and does not classify provider 5xx; dispatch recheck list incomplete vs the reference; several RACE cells name a lock that is not the serialization point; guarded-aggregate writers, time boundaries, stop triggers, compliance payload, permission evidence, non-registry stateful routes, lane tokens and producer census incomplete. Fixes are plan text + new titles; re-run the adversary on the revised plan before the Codex design review.

findings.title: The 10-new-recipient cap is judged under a FOR SHARE sender lock: two CMD063 of one sender on different prospects/grants both read 9 and both insert
findings.reproduction: Sender S has 9 new recipients in the last 24 h. CMD063 A (prospect P1, grant G1) and CMD063 B (prospect P2, grant G2): both take [3] on different prospects, [6] sender FOR SHARE (plan l.94 and l.127), [8] on different grants; both count 9, both insert: 11. GAP-SE-2 'held at the sender lock' is unreachable: FOR SHARE does not block FOR SHARE. The cap is also keyed per sender identity while the reference says 'per-person activity cap' and 18 says 'A seller cannot evade limits by adding another unapproved mailbox'.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Every writer of the new-recipient count takes one conflicting lock on the cap subject (the person, not the identity) before the count read, in the global order; the cap counts across all sender identities of one person; GAP-SE-2 uses that lock in both orders and is red with the lock downgraded to FOR SHARE.
findings.failing_test: cmd063 :: 'RACE (rolling cap): two CMD063 of one person on two prospects and two grants at 9 of 10, one held after its count at the cap lock: one 200, one 409 OUTREACH_CAP_REACHED; both orders; red with FOR SHARE' + 'DENY: a second sender identity of the same seller does not reset the cap'.

findings.title: SEND_UNCERTAIN reconciliation: a repeat is allowed after HUMAN_SEND_OBSERVED (the message WAS sent), and provider 5xx/REJECTED is not classified, so a possibly sent message can become NOT_SENT and be repeated
findings.reproduction: R2-129 title: 'CMD063 refuses a repeat until CMD064 HUMAN_SEND_OBSERVED closes it'. The reference closes uncertainty by observing the Sent view; an observation that the message was sent must make the draft count as sent (cadence, cap, no repeat); the plan defines no 'observed not sent' outcome and SalesActivity has no such kind. The port returns REJECTED{code} (l.206) and A3 admits SUBMITTING to NOT_SENT on 'no-effect proof' without naming the codes: a Gmail 500/503 mapped to REJECTED gives NOT_SENT, returns the grant (l.227) and admits a repeat.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Reconciliation outcomes and effects are stated: observed-sent closes SEND_UNCERTAIN as sent (counts in cadence and cap, no repeat of that draft); observed-not-sent with evidence is the only path to a repeat; an open SEND_UNCERTAIN counts in cadence and cap. A table maps every port result: only definitive pre-acceptance refusals (auth refused, 4xx validation, 429) are NOT_SENT; 5xx, reset, timeout, UNKNOWN and any lost answer are SEND_UNCERTAIN.
findings.failing_test: b12-dispatch-cells :: 'R2-129: after HUMAN_SEND_OBSERVED (sent) a CMD063 of the same draft is refused and the message counts toward the 14-day cadence; a repeat is admitted only after an observed-not-sent reconciliation' + 'R2-129: a Gmail 503 after the body was sent is SEND_UNCERTAIN, never NOT_SENT; zero further submissions'.

findings.reproduction: (a) CMD064 SUPPRESSED takes [3] prospect EXCLUSIVE before [7] (l.148); D2 (l.139) and CMD061 (l.103) take [3] shared: they serialize at [3], so R2-130 / CMD064-RACE / GAP-DR-2 'held at the suppression key' stay green with [7] removed. (b) D4 takes no [3] (l.141) but GAP-AC-1 is 'held at the prospect lock'; a D4 that loses UNIQUE(provider_message_ref, kind) rolls back and a known PROVIDER_ACCEPTED becomes SEND_UNCERTAIN via D5. (c) GAP-SUP-1 races an ORGANIZATION suppression but no B12 production writer writes ORGANIZATION keys (opt-out and CMD064 write CONTACT, l.154, l.76). (d) CMD062-RACE 'a draft re-bound' has no writer (no draft edit command). (e) the public opt-out writes prospect state and intents without [3]; its place in the order is unstated. (f) runtime.ts:298 run.access (authorizeSeller, commercial-sales.ts:339 shared kauro.sellers) runs BEFORE the journal reserve at runtime.ts:306.

findings.title: Time windows: no microsecond boundary or not-yet-valid cells; the follow-up rule can fire at 4 business days; the 'never looser' claims are false
findings.reproduction: (a) validFrom inclusive / expiresAt exclusive (contract) have no boundary cell at CMD063 or D2 and no 'before validFrom' DENY. (b) l.54-55 'follow-up at least 10 calendar days after the first (at least 5 US business days with up to 3 holidays)': first send Thu 2026-12-24, follow-up Sun 2027-01-03 = 10 days, business days between = Dec 28-31 = 4 (Dec 25 and Jan 1 are holidays), fewer than 18's 'five'. (c) l.53 'a rolling window is never looser than a business day' is false over weekends (10 Sat + 10 Sun + 10 Mon). (d) l.53 'no calendar exists for outreach' while the plan reads 17 'Business-day calendar'. (e) no cells for the 14-day upper bound, the 90-day stop or the 24 h edge.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Each window is judged at effect_now after the last lock with a cell at the exact microsecond on each side (validFrom admitted, 1 us before refused; expiresAt refused, 1 us before admitted; 24 h, 14-day and 90-day edges); the follow-up minimum uses the business-day calendar (at least 5 business days); the cap reading is never looser than 18 on any calendar day.
findings.failing_test: cmd063 :: 'EXPIRY (boundaries): grant at validFrom admitted, 1 us before refused; at expiresAt refused, 1 us before admitted' and 'DENY (cadence): a follow-up 10 calendar days after a 2026-12-24 first send is refused (4 business days)'.

findings.title: permissionEvidenceHash is the digest of the request's own fields: tautological, proves no explicit review
findings.reproduction: Review digest = sha256(canonical JSON {senderIdentityRef, sorted allowedContentHashes, validFrom, expiresAt, maximumSends}): any client computes it from the body it sends, so 'evidence equal to the server's review digest' (CMD062-OK) and 'evidence not the review digest' (CMD062-DENY) only check hashing. Contract: 'Actual explicit authorization'; command precondition: 'binds reviewed recipients/content'.
findings.acceptance_criterion: The evidence is a server-issued review record (owner session, exact draft ids, versions and content hashes shown, issued at the DB clock, single use, expiry) that CMD062 consumes under lock; a digest the server did not issue, issued to another session, for other versions, or reused, is refused.
findings.failing_test: cmd062 :: 'DENY: a client-computed digest of the same fields, a review issued to another owner session and a review of an earlier draft version are each 409 with nothing written'.

K adds about 9 tables guarded by KA095-097 but carries only forged-birth cells in one title (l.87): no UPDATE per guarded column, DELETE, TRUNCATE or reparent cells (rule 22) and no per-predicate control list (rule 12).
findings.acceptance_criterion: Each of the 6 routes has its matrix rows with titles; the kit lists one row per new table (INSERT, UPDATE per guarded column, DELETE, TRUNCATE, reparent) with its guard or 'not needed because', and one titled forged control per atomic predicate of KA095-097 and KC028-033.
